# yellowdog_group (Resource)

Manages a group.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A group gives its members -- users and applications -- the roles assigned to
# it. See yellowdog_group_role and yellowdog_group_application.
resource "yellowdog_group" "example" {
  name        = "example-group"
  description = "Managed by Terraform"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String)

### Optional

- `description` (String)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The import ID is the group's YDID.
terraform import yellowdog_group.example ydid:group:000000:00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000
```
